payload.reason: The evidence provides specific sources from which the data was obtained, including various literary, religious, and news sources, as well as public-domain texts and a corpus of journalistic news text.

claims.text: The data sources included varied text from conversational, literary, and religious sources, as well as news magazines and a book of proverbs.
Text was aggregated from a variety of online public-domain sources and physical books scanned using OCR software.
Global Voices, a corpus of journalistic news text, was selected as a source for modern, colloquial text.
